title: Time semantics
description: The five time meanings this contract allows, and the rule each carries. Canonical encoding is integer Unix MILLISECONDS, matching shared/contracts/schemas/event-envelope.json ('Unix milliseconds when the event occurred') and database/schema/executor-schema.sql ('timestamps are bigint unix MILLISECOND values'). KNOWN LEGACY DEVIATIONS in the repo, which a consumer must not read as this contract: database/schema/{schema.sql,pg-schema.sql} store created_at/updated_at as text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (seconds, no offset); identity/cookie.go SessionClaims.Exp is epoch SECONDS while identity.go Session.ExpiresAtMs is milliseconds; frontend/web/src/features/cryptorank/shapers.ts and the acquisition envelopes use seconds in `fetchedAt`. See docs/architecture/canonical-model.md section 4 for the full violation table (T1-T10).

occurred_at.title: occurred_at - when the fact happened in the world
occurred_at.description: Supplied by the source (venue fill clock, chain block time, event time), never by us. Carriers: ledger Entry.OccurredAtMs, audit Record.OccurredAtMs (validated > 0), notifications Request.OccurredAt, treasury Movement.OccurredAt, executor.fills.timestamp.

observed_at.title: observed_at - when this value was read from the source
observed_at.description: When we looked and read the number, distinct from when the number was true. Carriers: markets Ticker.Ts, Candle.OpenTime, FundingRate.NextFundingAt, TypeScript VenueQuote.at.

received_at.title: received_at - when the payload reached our process
received_at.description: Must move forward on every read, even when the body is served from cache. NO CARRIER EXISTS TODAY: the nearest field, `fetchedAt`, is set once at acquisition and reused verbatim on an L2 cache hit (backend/data/platform/cache/cache.go Encode/Decode carry the original fetchedAt on purpose), so it is an acquisition time, not a receipt time. A consumer CANNOT currently distinguish 'we read this 2 s ago' from 'we read this 2 s ago and the body is 59 s old'.

recorded_at.title: recorded_at - when the row was written to durable storage
recorded_at.description: Us, at the write. Carriers: ledger Entry.CreatedAt (deliberately excluded from the idempotency key so a re-delivered event does not fork a row), SQL assets.updated_at DEFAULT datetime('now'), executor.*.created_at bigint.

updated_at.title: updated_at - last mutation of a MUTABLE row
updated_at.description: Only for rows that are updated in place; a system-of-record row (execution_events, ledger entries) must not carry it. Semantics differ per table today: on `assets` it is a recorded_at written by the sync, on executor.child_orders it is a true last-mutation time.
